items.title: Bringing ChatGPT for Teachers to more U.S. school districts
items.summary: ChatGPT for Teachers is expanding to 55 U.S. school systems, bringing secure AI tools, training, and support to over 100,000 more educators and staff.

items.title: Learning never stops: How AI makes learning continuous
items.summary: OpenAI’s new report explores how students and educators use ChatGPT to make learning more continuous, with support that extends beyond the classroom.
